_about: Spoken narration for the /fitness chapter "health" (owner, 2026-10-01: "our fitness one needs this too", after hearing the MetFix Module 1 and 2 narration; amendment H.75). Its own script, not the captions: one paragraph per beat explaining what is on screen, in the order the picture builds, every sentence restating the lesson's own text (fitnessData.ts: INTRO_TEXT, DEFINITION_TEXT, POWER_CONCEPT, MODULE_COPY, SKILLS, ARCHETYPES, HOPPER_DOMAINS, ENERGY_SYSTEMS, ENERGY_BENCHMARKS, CONTINUUM_EXAMPLES) and the captions, no new facts or numbers; each beat names its passage. The voice is Charon. Edit a sentence and narration-check fails until its clip is regenerated (voice/ pipeline), copied into public/narration/fitness/health/ and node scripts/narration-manifest.mjs has run. Plain hyphens only.

gates.why: Paragraph narration breathes between sentences (the owner-approved Charon audition pauses 0.82 s; Modules 1 and 2 measure up to 1.04 s). Every clip was generated with the 1.6 s inner-pause gate (voice/gen_chapter.py MAX_INNER), the MetFix Module 1 and 2 recipe the owner approved on 2026-10-01.

_sync: The picture follows the voice (amendment H.74): each anchor [t, at, offset] lands build t on a sentence (an index, 0 first) or a phrase of the paragraph, at its first word plus offset seconds. Reveals land on their words: the age-30 curve is drawn from "curve once more" through "power against duration", its area sweeps in on "the area under it is your fitness" and AGE 30 lands on "third axis: age"; the slices fly in front to back from "Each slice" (age 20) to "into old age" (age 85), fuse on "Fuse them together" and the solid's walls land on "solid"; the volume pours from "volume" to "lifetime" and VOLUME = HEALTH lands on "how much capacity you keep"; the red plane rises on "independence line", its edge is drawn on "this red plane" and INDEPENDENCE LINE lands on "Below it"; the surface sinks from "sinks", the power ridge is down on "collapses first", the HUD reaches its low on "The volume shrinks" and Independent through 70 lands on "falls below the line"; the scanner reaches age 50 on "fifty" and sweeps the lift through "the surface rises behind it" and "reclaim capacity", with Starts at 50 and Independent through 85+ on "even into the nineties"; the Lifelong surface rises through "the surface stays high", the Sedentary ghost is named by "sedentary ghost", the amber slice sweeps the ages through "Maximize the area under the curve, at every age" and Independent through 90+ lands on "hold it for as long as you can".

slice.source: MODULE_COPY health s1 to s2; DEFINITION_TEXT s2
slice.text: Here is the fitness curve once more: power against duration, and the area under it is your fitness. Now add a third axis: age. Every age of your life has its own power-duration curve.

stack.text: Stack them. Each slice is the same person, at a different age, from young adulthood into old age. Fuse them together, and the three-dimensional solid that results is health.

volume.text: Health is the volume under that surface: sustained work capacity across a lifetime. It is not merely living a long time. It is how much capacity you keep, for how long.

line.source: MODULE_COPY health s6 (the independence line, where daily tasks exceed capacity)
line.text: Now add the independence line: this red plane. Below it, everyday tasks exceed your capacity. So far, the whole surface sits well above it.

sink.source: MODULE_COPY health s6; caption (The power ridge collapses first); keyPoints 3
sink.text: Stop training, and the whole surface sinks toward the independence line. The power ridge collapses first: without training, strength and especially power decline fastest. The volume shrinks, and more of life falls below the line.

any-age.source: MODULE_COPY health s7; keyPoints 4; AGING_PROFILES Starts at 50
any-age.text: But start at any age, and it lifts. Here, someone starts training at fifty, and as the scanner sweeps forward through the years, the surface rises behind it. Resistance and power training reclaim capacity, even into the nineties.

hold.text: So here is the goal. Train for life, and the surface stays high, far above where the sedentary ghost lies. Maximize the area under the curve, at every age, and hold it for as long as you can.
